infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Monocular uses your photo library so you can select drawings, plans, or project images to create architectural-style renders.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Monocular saves finished renders to your photo library so you can access and share them later.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Monocular looks up the address you type to add real site context to your render. Your device's current location is never accessed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Monocular uses the camera to photograph your plan sketch, which it reads on this phone to build a 3D model.
